subject: English
question_text: Flowers can be a source of your income if you–
stimulus: Have you ever thought of a very delicate career? Have you dreamt of a rosy environment full of colour and fragrance? Daisies, violets, tulips, marigolds, dahlias, bellies, jasmines, roses and all those things of beauty can also earn you a living if you handle them professionally. In fact, a florist’s career is rather a good choice as an unconventional job for many around | 211 (c) How does he earn his livelihood? (d) How does he attract the customers?
